name: Hassan Taj
overview: Senior Software Engineer and Microsoft Certified Azure Solutions Architect Expert delivering enterprise applications with .NET, Angular, and React while expanding into solution architecture, cloud modernization, identity, and platform engineering.
about_intro: I have 7+ years of experience building and modernizing enterprise software. My work spans hands-on application delivery, technical leadership, system and application architecture, API and database design, cloud migration planning, and direct collaboration with clients and stakeholders.
about_tech: My core implementation stack is C#, .NET, ASP.NET Core, Angular, React, and TypeScript. I also work with Azure, AWS, GraphQL, REST, gRPC, microservices, relational and document databases, containers, CI/CD, and modern authentication standards.
about_desc: I care about the complete lifecycle of a solution: requirements, architecture, maintainable implementation, security, deployment, observability, recovery, documentation, and developer experience. My personal engineering work extends this into reusable application foundations and self-hosted platform operations.
